description: This file defines a Java interface named UnaryOperation, which extends another interface called Operation. It declares a method perform that takes a float argument and returns a float result, representing a unary operation in a calculator or similar context.

classes.name: UnaryOperation
classes.description: A Java interface representing a unary operation, extending the Operation interface, with a method to perform the operation on a float argument.

methods.name: perform
methods.description: Performs the unary operation on the given float argument and returns the result.
